open_gates.title: XP1 power-entry current arithmetic not recalculated for IS-3 loads
open_gates.blocking_condition: The IS-2 quote (3.011 A @ 18 V) was computed for IS-2 loads. IS-3 changes the load set (8 motor channels, per-bank selectable fused 5/12/24 V field supply, 8 switchable-range AI, DO24); no IS-3 load numbers exist yet, so the power-entry arithmetic cannot be closed.
open_gates.required_evidence: Recalculated XP1 power-entry current arithmetic for the IS-3 load set, at the selected field-supply settings, with derating and per-bank fuse sizing; reviewed and signed by the power design owner.

open_gates.title: Switchable-range AI: E3 envelope review of the 8x3 position pattern
open_gates.blocking_condition: The 3-pos/AI position pattern is retained (8 x 3 = 24 positions on XAI), but the per-channel contacts and switching scheme must fit the E3 part envelope; the E3 review has not been done.
open_gates.required_evidence: E3 envelope review record confirming the 3-position per-channel pattern (24 positions total) fits, including contact ratings for switchable ranges; post-E3 only.

open_gates.title: DO16 -> 24 touches the unqualified FPGA pin budget
open_gates.blocking_condition: complete_FPGA_pin_budget_qualified is false in IS-2; adding XDO2 (DO16-DO23, 12 positions) claims FPGA resources that have not been qualified. No DO24 claim may be made before the recheck.
open_gates.required_evidence: Vendor FPGA pin/bank recheck covering the +12 DO positions (and the IS-3 AI/encoder changes), with updated bank utilization; complete_FPGA_pin_budget_qualified flips to true only after this evidence exists.

open_gates.title: Supplies and shields on added DO/AI positions not derivable
open_gates.blocking_condition: The added DO positions (XDO2) and added AI positions (XAI 12 -> 24) require 15 shields and per-bank AUX loop supplies that cannot be derived from the current documents; the power design pass has not run.
open_gates.required_evidence: Power design pass producing the supply/shield plan for the added DO/AI positions: 15 shields, per-bank AUX loop supplies, fuse selection, and updated XP1 entry arithmetic (feeds ND-1).
